title: India Wants Isobutanol in Both Diesel and Jet Fuel. It Has Built a Domestic Supply Chain for Neither.

version_history.note: Publish: isobutanol as both a diesel-blend and Alcohol-to-Jet SAF feedstock, and correcting an unsubstantiated 'MC2 design challenge at IIT Madras' claim against the real MC2 Foundation programmes. Also updates the earlier Gevo/A.E. Innovation ethanol-plant-sale post: the deal (reported in August as pending) closed around November 2025.
